newsitem.title: RUSSIA: Chinese PM in Moscow, likely to meet Yeltsin.
newsitem.headline: Chinese PM in Moscow, likely to meet Yeltsin.

text.p: Chinese Premier Li Peng arrived in Moscow on Thursday for a three-day visit to Russia which may include a meeting with President Boris Yeltsin on Friday, Russian news agencies said.
The meeting would make Li the first foreign leader to see Yeltsin since the 65-year-old Kremlin chief returned to the Kremlin on Monday following his heart bypass operation on November 5.
Diplomats in Beijing said the main focus of Li's trip would be to boost economic links and pave the way for a visit to Moscow by Chinese President and Communist Party chief Jiang Zemin in 1997.
Li is also scheduled to meet Prime Minister Viktor Chernomyrdin on Friday.
Officials on both sides have said economic ties have failed to keep pace with the rapid improvement in political links between the former rivals for world communist leadership.
